items.html: And behold, it follows that when she is in the back, she is secondary to him and needs him to shine in her; and he opens his eyes to gaze and look upon her. But he looks only at the place of his Chazeh, and from there the light of his eyes pierces and comes out to the back and shines in her, according to what was in the emanation itself. And while he looks upon her, Arich Anpin also looks, gazes, and observes ZA, as mentioned in the Idra Rabba.
